entities.summary: Johannes Kleimen was a Dutch resident who helped hide Anne Frank and her family in the Netherlands in World War II. In the published version of Frank's diary, Het Achterhuis, known in English as The Diary of a Young Girl, he is given the pseudonym Mr. Koophuis. In some later publications of the diary, the pseudonym was removed, and Kleiman was referred to by his real name.
